title: First promotion: create main as a fast-forward of dev
summary: Step 3 of 5 in the user-approved main-branch migration. Creates the main branch for the first time via git push origin dev:main -- there is no existing main to open a PR against for this bootstrap step, unlike every future promotion, which will follow opum-sdlc's normal PR-then-push ritual. dev's tip at push time already carries passing check-runs for all four contexts the new require-ci-on-main ruleset (OMARK-30) requires, verified before pushing. Confirms after: all four refs agree (dev, main, origin/dev, origin/main), the default branch did not move (gh api .default_branch still dev, matching every sibling repo's own model where main is never the default), and promotion-guards.yml's push-triggered main-is-fast-forward-of-dev job actually fired and passed for this exact push -- the failure mode opum-doc's ODOC-155 caught happening silently elsewhere.

acceptanceCriteria.text: dev's tip commit has passing check-runs for all four required contexts before pushing -- verified, not assumed.
git push origin dev:main succeeds as a plain push (no --force anywhere), creating main.
All four refs (dev, main, origin/dev, origin/main) agree on the same SHA after the push and a local sync.
GitHub's default_branch is still dev after main exists -- confirmed via gh api, not assumed.

promotion-guards.yml's main-is-fast-forward-of-dev job actually ran (not just exists) and passed for this specific push -- confirmed via gh run list / gh api, matching the exact verification opum-doc's runbook says was skipped before ODOC-155 caught it.

implementationNotes: Pushed at 2026-09-09T18:13 UTC-ish: git push origin dev:main, plain push, no --force. All four refs verified equal afterward (dev main origin/dev origin/main all 3d33da9). Default branch confirmed still dev via gh api. Both workflows fired on the push (run 34387647123 'ci', run 34387647267 'promotion guards'), both passed; within the latter, 'main landed via fast-forward from dev' actually ran and succeeded, 'dev-to-main promotion is a manual fast-forward push' correctly skipped (pull_request-only, no PR involved in a plain push) -- confirming the trigger-scoping fix ODOC-155 required in opum-doc actually works here, not just exists on paper.
finalSummary: main created for the first time at 3d33da9 (== dev's tip), fast-forward verified live by promotion-guards.yml's own push-triggered job, not just by local git commands. Default branch unchanged. No repo file changes -- this task is the promotion act itself.
